messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 51 13 aluminum window frame detail at the corner window are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. No hard deadline, just would like to keep this moving.

Detail 5/A501 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 51 13 aluminum window frame detail at the corner window; we'll reconcile Door and Window Schedule A-601 by addendum. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected.
